scenarios.title: Display parameter inputs for API calls on the main page
given: The user visits the main page.
scenarios.when: The user views the interface options for triggering API calls.
then: Input fields for entering parameter values are displayed alongside API calls that support parameters.

scenarios.title: Execute an API call with a user-supplied parameter value
given: The user is on the main page.
An API call that accepts a parameter is present.
scenarios.when: The user enters a specific parameter value (e.g. 'val123') into the input field and runs the call.
then: The API call executes using the supplied parameter value.
The output or response content from the executed call is displayed to the user.

scenarios.title: Execute an API call with multiple user-supplied parameter values
given: The user is on the main page.
An API call that accepts multiple parameters is present.
scenarios.when: The user enters values into each corresponding parameter field (e.g. 'firstvalue' and 'secondvalue') and runs the call.
then: The API call executes incorporating all supplied parameter values.
The resulting data reflecting the combined parameters is displayed.

scenarios.title: Attempting to run an API call without supplying a required parameter
given: The user is on the main page.
An API call requiring a parameter is present.
scenarios.when: The user attempts to trigger the API call while leaving the parameter field empty.
then: A visible indication is presented stating that the parameter value is required.
The call is prevented from executing with missing required input.

scenarios.title: Update parameter values and re-run the API call
given: The user is on the main page.
The user has executed an API call with an initial parameter value.
scenarios.when: The user replaces the parameter value with a new value (e.g. 'updated456') and triggers the call again.
then: The API call runs with the updated parameter value.
The displayed result reflects the outcome of the new execution.

scenarios.title: Execute an API call with special characters in parameter values
given: The user is on the main page.
An API call parameter input field is displayed.
scenarios.when: The user enters a parameter value containing special characters or spaces (e.g. 'item 123-test') and executes the call.
then: The API call is run with the entered parameter value.
The resulting response is displayed to the user.
